title: Update README badges for active workflow
body:
README badges were pointing at an inactive workflow path and lacking target links. This updates badge URLs to reflect the current GitHub Actions workflow and relevant destinations.

- **CI badge**: Point to the active workflow badge and link to the workflow page.
- **Repository badges**: Add links to the license and releases pages for quicker navigation.

Example:

```md
[![CI](https://github.com/neat-tools/Neat/actions/workflows/copilot-swe-agent/copilot/badge.svg)](https://github.com/neat-tools/Neat/actions/workflows/copilot-swe-agent/copilot)
```
